contract: Expand uploaded RFC 5545 recurrence within an explicit maximum-366-day window while preserving the source timezone's wall time across DST. Apply bounded DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY and YEARLY RRULE intervals/counts/until and common BYDAY/BYMONTHDAY/BYMONTH selectors, RDATE additions, EXDATE exclusions, RECURRENCE-ID moves and cancellations. Persist stable UID-plus-original-occurrence provenance in the canonical calendar event store. Provider window instances retain provider IDs and cancellation state.
acceptance: Daily recurrence crosses a real IANA DST boundary at constant local wall time and applies move, cancellation, exclusion and addition exceptions
Weekly BYDAY, monthly negative BYMONTHDAY, yearly selectors and all-day exclusive ends expand deterministically within a bounded window
Unsupported RRULE components, invalid counts or intervals, mismatched value types, duplicate overrides and windows beyond 366 days fail closed without replacing stored events
Re-import dedup includes both source content and expansion window; changed exceptions replace current occurrences without old replay resurrection
Provider instance IDs and cancellations remain canonical, while real HTTP and console ICS upload and daily-review journeys expose expanded occurrences
limits: RRULE expansion supports one start time per recurrence date and fails closed on unsupported sub-daily or BYSETPOS forms rather than claiming partial expansion.
ICS expansion is bounded to 366 days and 5000 occurrences; snapshot coverage applies only inside the declared expansion window.
Google Calendar and Outlook calendarView remain the authoritative recurrence expanders for remote provider windows; successful live provider qualification requires customer credentials.
Daily review shows scheduled events and cancellations, not proof of attendance.
